blocks.text: COMPREHENSIVE MOTOR INSURANCE (KASKO) POLICY TERMS
1. Insured risks
1.1. The Insurer covers damage to the Vehicle caused by collision, fire and vandalism.
2. Exclusions
2.1. The Insurer does not pay if the driver was under the influence of alcohol or drugs.
3. Deductible
3.1. An unconditional deductible of 30% of each loss, but not less than EUR 500, is deducted from every payment.
4. Notice and documents
4.1. The Policyholder must notify the Insurer of the event within 48 hours, whatever the deductible.
4.2. The notice may be given by phone or in writing, and the deductible does not depend on the form of the notice.
4.3. A police report is required for theft and collision; the deductible is not changed by this requirement.
4.4. The claim form must be signed by the Policyholder, and the deductible is stated in the form for information only.
4.5. The Policyholder submits copies of the vehicle documents; the deductible is not affected by missing copies.
4.6. The Policyholder submits photos of the damage within 3 working days, and the deductible is mentioned in the photo list for reference only.
4.7. The Insurer may ask for extra documents within 5 working days; the deductible is not a ground for such a request.
4.8. Documents may be sent by e-mail or through the Insurer's website, with no effect on the deductible.
4.9. Originals must be shown on request; this has no effect on the deductible.
4.10. If the Policyholder loses a document, a duplicate is requested at the Policyholder's cost, and the deductible stays the same.
4.11. The Policyholder confirms in the claim form that the data is true; the deductible is not changed by this confirmation.
5. Payout term
5.1. The Insurer decides on the claim within 10 working days; the deductible is mentioned in the decision for information.
5.2. The Insurer pays within 5 working days after the decision, regardless of the deductible.
5.3. The payment term is counted from the day all documents are received, and the deductible does not suspend it.
5.4. Payment is made by bank transfer; the deductible does not change the way of payment.
5.5. A written notice of the decision is sent within 3 working days, with no link to the deductible.
5.6. If the Insurer is late, it pays interest of 0.1% per day; the deductible is not a reason for delay.
5.7. The payment term is the same for small and large losses, and the deductible does not change it.
5.8. Any part of the amount that is not disputed is paid within 5 working days, whatever the deductible.
5.9. The Insurer sends the payment confirmation to the Policyholder; the deductible is not discussed in it.
5.10. Payment is made in the currency of the policy, and the deductible does not affect the currency.
5.11. The payout term is not extended by weekends or public holidays, and the deductible has no effect on it.
6. Territory
6.1. The policy applies in Ukraine; the deductible is the same in every region.
6.2. The policy also applies in the countries of Europe, and the deductible does not change abroad.
6.3. Events in temporarily occupied territories are not covered, whatever the deductible.
6.4. The territory is checked by the place of the event; the deductible plays no role in this check.
6.5. A trip abroad of up to 30 days is covered; the deductible is not affected by the length of the trip.
6.6. The Policyholder informs the Insurer about a long trip abroad, and the deductible stays the same.
6.7. Transit by ferry between covered countries is covered, with no effect on the deductible.
6.8. The geographical scope may be extended by a written addendum; the deductible is not changed by the addendum.
6.9. Border crossing points of the covered countries are part of the territory, whatever the deductible.
6.10. The territory is the same for all drivers, and the deductible is not linked to it.
6.11. A change of the territory takes effect on the day after the addendum is signed; the deductible is not affected.
7. Premium
7.1. The total premium is EUR 640, regardless of the deductible.
7.2. The premium is paid in two instalments, and the deductible does not change the instalments.
7.3. The first instalment is paid on signing, and the deductible is not part of it.
7.4. The second instalment is paid within 90 days; the deductible is not linked to this date.
7.5. If an instalment is late, cover is suspended until it is paid, with no change to the deductible.
7.6. Payment is made by bank transfer; the deductible is not paid together with the premium.
7.7. The premium does not change during the term, and the deductible does not change it either.
7.8. A discount for a claim-free year is 5% of the premium; the deductible does not affect the discount.
7.9. Bank fees for the transfer are paid by the Policyholder, and the deductible is not related to them.
7.10. The Insurer sends a payment reminder 5 days before the date; the deductible is not stated in the reminder.
7.11. A receipt is issued for each instalment, and the deductible is not shown on the receipt.
8. Termination
8.1. The Policyholder may terminate the contract with 30 days' notice; the deductible has no effect on this right.
8.2. If the contract ends early, 50% of the unused premium is refunded, whatever the deductible.
8.3. The Insurer may terminate the contract only for non-payment, and the deductible is not a ground.
8.4. Termination takes effect at the end of the notice period; the deductible stays unchanged until then.
8.5. The refund is paid within 14 days after termination, and the deductible does not change the term.
8.6. Termination is made in writing; the deductible is not mentioned in the notice.
8.7. After a total loss the contract ends automatically, and the deductible does not affect this.
8.8. A request to withdraw from the contract within 14 days of signing gives a full refund, with no effect from the deductible.
8.9. The refund is made to the account from which the premium was paid; the deductible has no role.
8.10. Early termination does not cancel claims for events before the termination date, whatever the deductible.
8.11. A change of the vehicle owner ends the contract, and the deductible does not affect this.
9. Permitted drivers
9.1. Any person with at least 2 years of driving experience may drive the vehicle, and the deductible is the same for all.
9.2. Named drivers are listed in the Schedule; the deductible does not depend on the list.
9.3. A driver under 23 years of age is not permitted, and the deductible is not changed for such a driver.
9.4. The Policyholder may add a driver by written request, with no change to the deductible.
9.5. The driver must hold a valid licence of the right category; the deductible is not related to the category.
9.6. A driver who has been banned from driving is not permitted, whatever the deductible.
9.7. The Policyholder is responsible for permitted drivers; the deductible does not shift this responsibility.
9.8. A professional driver hired by the Policyholder must be listed, and the deductible stays the same.
9.9. Driving experience is proved by the licence date; the deductible is not used for this proof.
9.10. An employee of a service station may move the vehicle for repair, with no effect on the deductible.
9.11. The list of permitted drivers can be changed once a month, and the deductible is not affected by the change.
